title: M2SVid: Monocular-to-Stereo Video Conversion
summary: M2SVid is a Google Research project that converts 2D monocular videos into stereoscopic 3D. It utilizes a conditional latent diffusion model based on Stable Video Diffusion to generate the missing right-eye view with high temporal consistency.
research_notes: Uses a single-step feed-forward prediction architecture; supports high-resolution outputs through spatial and temporal stitching techniques.

evolution.summary: After appearing as a research paper in mid-2025, the project was accepted to 3DV 2026 and the official source code and pre-trained weights were released in March 2026. It is currently recognized for being significantly faster than previous iterative diffusion-based stereoscopic methods.
